opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid access to OneCoin through priced One Academy packages, ranging from €110 to €5500, while connecting those packages to token access, private mining, coin earning, and market trading. The speaker reinforces the financial appeal by claiming, "We're up almost eleven-fold From when I started to today," and describes tokens being placed in a private mining pool to mine digital currency coins. The structure also ties earnings to recruitment across successive generations, including a stated 10% return linked to recruited people making 5,000 for the week, while another account describes €550 for introducing a buyer. Although the product is characterized as education rather than an investment, the presentation combines paid packages, mining-related returns, claimed past growth, referral rewards, and an urging to join quickly. Institutional associations remain speaker claims and are not independently established.

citations.quote: Dr. Ruja just so happens to give us free tokens that we can put in our private mining pool. And we can mine those tokens for digital currency coins
